caseName: Hanson-Hodge v. Barnhart, Commissioner of Social Security
caseNameFull: Hanson-Hodge v. Barnhart, Commissioner of Social Security

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. Petitioner is allowed until December 22, 2003, within which to pay the docketing fee *1045 required by Rule 38(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
